project_scope.note: T. filifolium var. filifolium is represented by canonical T. filifolium. Source-name T. ambiguum maps to the provisional installed T. megapotamicum var. ambiguum concept; its taxonomy/range HOLD remains explicit and native metrics stay excluded.

study_strategy.warning: Do not use the old T. ambiguum source name as proof of a separate species in the learner. The project currently teaches that source concept through provisional T. megapotamicum var. ambiguum while preserving the Kew/ITIS treatment split.
